subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] A simple bug in mqmscanall?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] A simple bug in mqmscanall?
parts:
Ideally we will revise the MQM-related functions to have a pheno.col argument for selecting phenotype columns.

karl


On Sep 11, 2012, at 2:16 PM, John wrote:

> Hi,
>
> As you know, read.cross treats "id" as a phenotype, but scanone would ignore it it during analysis.
>
> However, it appears to me that the mqmscanall in my copy qtl (1.25) does not ignore "id" and go on performing genome scan as if id was a normal phenotype.
>
> mqmheatmap didn't seem to recognize this either, so when I feed the mqmmulti object such produced, mqmheatmap would give a "phenotype id is not numeric" error.
>
> A workaround is available for that (ripping off the id from the original cross), I think this still needs to be fixed...
>
> In the long term, I think, the "id" should actually be separated from cross$pheno so that coders would not confuse the real nature of "id".
>
> Cheers,
>
> John Ma
> Kwitek Lab
> Department of Pharmacology
> The University of Iowa
> Iowa City, IA, USA
